parent.title: Malaysia, Coast to Coast to Borneo: A First-Timer's 2–3 Week Crossing

siblings.title: Getting to Malaysia from Ghent + entry/visa for a Belgian couple (2026)
siblings.summary: Fly into KLIA (Kuala Lumpur) — it's the cheapest, best-connected, and natural start of a West-Coast route; Belgians get 90 days visa-free but must file the free MDAC within 3 days of arrival.

siblings.title: Getting between the bases: internal transport for a routed Malaysia trip (2026)
siblings.summary: Fly the long and awkward hops, take the train/bus for the short scenic west-coast ones; every Borneo hop and the cross-peninsula jump to the Perhentians is a flight.

siblings.title: When to Visit Malaysia: One Trip, Three Regions, One Window
siblings.summary: Late March–May is the one window where the east-coast islands and Borneo are both open and dry while the haze hasn't yet arrived; June–July is the runner-up.

siblings.title: Malaysia First-Visit Prep: Money, SIM, Health, Etiquette, Safety & Budget
siblings.summary: Practical money, SIM, health, etiquette, safety and per-couple budget prep for a Belgian couple's first 2-3 week Malaysia trip in 2026.

siblings.title: Malaysia in 2-3 weeks: the routed first-visit itinerary
siblings.summary: One sensible order for a first Malaysia trip: a west-coast sweep, an east-coast wild leg, then Borneo - with a recommended nights-split, 12-14 day and 3-week+ variants, and the Nov-Feb monsoon reroute.

sources.title: Penang crowned Asia's best street-food city
sources.claim: Penang/George Town crowned Asia's best street-food city, ahead of Bangkok, Singapore, Hanoi and Chiang Mai.

sources.title: CNN: George Town, Asia's greatest street-food city?
sources.claim: CNN frames George Town, Penang as Asia's greatest street-food city.

sources.title: MICHELIN Guide: Siam Road Char Koay Teow
sources.claim: Char koay teow is cooked over charcoal at Michelin-listed Siam Road in George Town.

sources.title: Air Itam Laksa, Penang
sources.claim: Air Itam assam laksa — sour mackerel-tamarind noodles — sits at the foot of Kek Lok Si.

sources.title: Restaurant Ban Lee Siang, Melaka (satay celup)
sources.claim: Satay celup, a communal peanut-sauce hotpot, is a Malacca signature (e.g. Ban Lee Siang).

sources.title: Choon Hui Cafe, Kuching (Sarawak laksa)
sources.claim: Sarawak laksa, Bourdain's 'breakfast of the gods,' is served at Choon Hui in Kuching and sells out by lunch.

sources.title: Jalan Alor, Kuala Lumpur
sources.claim: KL's Jalan Alor offers a whole hawker evening with a meal under RM20.

sources.title: Sepilok Orangutan Rehabilitation Centre
sources.claim: Wild/rehabilitating orangutans feed at the Sepilok Orangutan Rehabilitation Centre in Sabah.

sources.title: Semenggoh Wildlife Centre, Sarawak
sources.claim: Semenggoh near Kuching offers near-guaranteed orangutan feeding sightings for RM10.

sources.title: Kinabatangan River Cruise
sources.claim: Kinabatangan dawn and night cruises give the best odds for pygmy elephants, proboscis monkeys and hornbills.

sources.title: Bako National Park, Sarawak
sources.claim: Bako National Park near Kuching has wild proboscis monkeys and bearded pigs.

sources.title: Sipadan: one of the world's best dive destinations
sources.claim: Sipadan is rated among the world's best dive destinations.

sources.title: Sipadan Diving — Bluewater
sources.claim: Sipadan hosts 3,000+ fish species and Barracuda Point's swirling barracuda vortex.

sources.title: Taman Negara is older than the Amazon
sources.claim: Taman Negara is a ~130-million-year-old rainforest, older than the Amazon.

sources.title: Perhentian Islands — Wikivoyage
sources.claim: The Perhentians are car-free jungle islands with turquoise water, blacktip reef sharks and green turtles.

sources.title: Snorkeling Shark Point, Perhentian
sources.claim: Shark Point in the Perhentians is a named beach-accessible snorkel site for blacktip sharks.

sources.title: Kinabalu Park — UNESCO World Heritage
sources.claim: Kinabalu Park is Malaysia's natural UNESCO World Heritage Site.

sources.title: Melaka & George Town — UNESCO World Heritage
sources.claim: Melaka and George Town were jointly inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2008 for 500 years of East-West trade.

sources.title: George Town: from port city to World Heritage site
sources.claim: George Town's outstanding value is living, lived-in multicultural heritage, not a museum.

sources.title: Petronas Twin Towers — admission & ticketing
sources.claim: The Petronas Twin Towers run timed-entry skybridge-and-deck visits in KL.

sources.title: Malaysia #1 in Asia for English proficiency 2025
sources.claim: Malaysia ranks #1 in Asia on the EF English Proficiency Index 2025, in the high-proficiency band.

sources.title: Malaysia entry requirements
sources.claim: EU citizens enter Malaysia visa-free for up to 90 days, needing only the free online MDAC.

sources.title: MYR to EUR converter
sources.claim: In 2026 €1 is roughly RM4.7, making a hawker plate about €1-3.

sources.title: Malaysia overtakes Thailand & Vietnam: 10M+ arrivals Q1 2026
sources.claim: Malaysia welcomed 10M+ tourists in Q1 2026, overtaking Thailand and Vietnam for a regional arrivals record.

sources.title: Vietnam cost vs Southeast Asia 2026
sources.claim: Vietnam is cheaper per week than Malaysia, but Malaysia wins on wildlife and food diversity.

sources.title: Southeast Asia: where to travel
sources.claim: Malaysia is less trampled than Thailand and combines modern cities with Borneo wilderness in one country.
